response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_price_ratio) AS overall_avg_price_ratio, AVG(num_invoice_line_items) AS avg_num_invoice_line_items FROM (SELECT order_item_id, COUNT(*) AS num_invoice_line_items, AVG(CASE WHEN product_price IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost != 0 THEN product_price / derived_total_cost ELSE NULL END) AS avg_price_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY order_item_id) subquery
